Inspect genuine output/trace for each claimed completed bounded operation; distinguish user-facing Project capabilities from the standalone Node reference host, list the original seven-category gaps, and make no claim of general or automatic interception.

For claimed operations, distinguish actual tool grant/provider execution, released trace, durable task/evidence and private source-read receipt where relevant, from unavailable or merely reported observations. Verify negative unauthenticated/invalid-auth/unsafe/unavailable paths and register missing signed-JWT production adversarial coverage and exact ChatGPT-to-MCP payload provenance without implying they were tested.

Record the owner's explicit practical-usefulness acceptance, actual per-source bounded timing/tool counts, prior reported UI labels, missing human corrections, cost and tokens as null, and precise direct-assistant comparison limitations. Do not claim statistically controlled speed/outcome superiority or increase original-case success counts from distinct structured/native sessions.

Publish pinned reproducible implementation/security/evidence fixtures with exact-head CI, verified combined-head compatibility and a **new independent review** of the specific revised milestone acceptance. Keep `PP-0007` open until separate authorized GitHub branch protections and any required reviewed deployment and safe post-deploy checks are complete; require a correctly pinned new `reviewTarget` and evidence-safe ledger transition before starting dependent roadmap items.
